findings.location: Article, paragraph beginning “David Cooper was speaking”
findings.source_quote: “And my prayer for you is that you would be delivered in the name of Jesus.”
findings.suggested_fix: “और आपके लिए मेरी प्रार्थना है कि यीशु के नाम में आप छुटकारा पाएँ।”
findings.translation_quote: “और आपके लिए मेरी प्रार्थना है कि यीशु के नाम में आपका उद्धार हो।”

findings.location: Article, paragraph beginning “I was seriously making plans to run away again”
findings.source_quote: “A greater Head had a better idea.”

findings.translation_quote: “एक महानतर मस्तिष्क की योजना इससे बेहतर थी।”

findings.location: Article, paragraph containing the quoted sermon beginning “I want to thank all of you visitors”
